content.text: Governing law and venue sit at §§ 26–27.

input.quote: 26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: The Agreement is governed by California law (§ 26) and disputes go exclusively to the state or federal courts located in San Luis Obispo County, California (§ 27), with consent to jurisdiction and a waiver of forum objections. California law and California courts are expressly within the playbook's fallback position, and disputes are routed to courts rather than to arbitration, let alone a foreign seat, so this is not walk-away territory. The clause therefore sits at the fallback and is not redlined. Noted but not flagged: the forum is not our preferred New York law / New York County courts, and the venue is pinned to a single California county that is likely convenient to the Vendor rather than to us; if this Agreement is reopened we could seek New York or at least a broader California venue. The § 28 fee-shifting reference to California Civil Code section 1717 is consistent with the chosen law and raises no separate governing-law issue.
